analogy.rationale: Antiinfective drugs lack annotated human targets and generally act on pathogen-specific machinery, so they should produce little or no transcriptional response in human cell lines; other antiinfective classes share this property, with antivirals and antiprotozoals/antimalarials being the closest because they also target non-human pathways.
